Hi all,

Per our leadership kickoff, attached is the working OKR draft for Q3 (OKR-draft-v1.xlsx) and the current QBR agenda (QBR-agenda-v2.pdf). I highlighted three open dependency areas that need quick alignment before we go to exec sign-off:

1) Deduping metrics across Optimize and Dedicated billing (Product/Finance) — line 7 in the sheet.
2) SLA target for Dedicated (p50 vs p95 tradeoff) — Ops decision required.
3) Partner catalog gating: whether marketplace launches count toward GTM target.

Asks:
- Can each owner review the dependency lines in the attached sheet and add a concise mitigation or owner by EOD Thursday? (See column H)
- Vivek — would like your ruling on the SLA framing (p50 vs p95) so we can present a single ask to execs.
- Laura — can you confirm the QBR facilitator and final slide owner?

We'll consolidate changes and aim to send the sign-off packet to Exec (Markus and Finance SVP) on Friday.

Thanks,

Irene
